mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known to exhibit coherent and consistent models for evaluating thought."
Logical systems are known to exhibit coherent and consistent models for evaluating thought.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are described as arguments in relation to the verbs in the sentence."
Nouns and noun phrases are described as arguments in relation to the verbs in the sentence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the force behind the utterances."
Illocutionary Acts - Illocutionary acts are the force behind the utterances.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the actual effect of the speaker's utterance on the action, behaviour, attitude or belief of the hearer."
The perlocutionary effect is the actual effect of the speaker's utterance on the action, behaviour, attitude or belief of the hearer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the natural association and sequence of words in longer structures."
Collocation is the natural association and sequence of words in longer structures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the area of linguistics dealing with the meaning of words or the meaning attached to words or symbols."
Semantics is the area of linguistics dealing with the meaning of words or the meaning attached to words or symbols.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only surviving son of a widow."
The accused is the only surviving son of a widow.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ideal variety used in official business, the mass media and for instruction in English public schools."
The Standard British English is the ideal variety used in official business, the mass media and for instruction in English public schools.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basic idea on which other ideas and conclusions are based."
A premise is the basic idea on which other ideas and conclusions are based.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in a variety of ways, some of which may be different from the normal everyday form."
Language is used in a variety of ways, some of which may be different from the normal everyday form.
fib: ______ is concerned with the range of choices and constraints available to users, and based on the context.
Pragmatics
Pragmatics is concerned with the range of choices and constraints available to users, and based on the context.
______ is the verbal element in a proposition and it is represented in capital letters.
predicator
A predicator is the verbal element in a proposition and it is represented in capital letters.

Pun or paronomasia is a conscious play on the meaning of words that have identical spellings or sounds, but with different meanings.
______ refers to the full range of all meaningful words of a language.
Lexis
Lexis refers to the full range of all meaningful words of a language.

Sense
Sense is an expression of the system of semantic relationships a given word keeps with other expressions in a given language.

Noam Chomsky
Noam Chomsky is the father of generative grammar.
______ is an aspect of the innate cognitive ability of human beings.
Knowledge of grammar

syntactic component
